overall.derivation: The top's stated plan size, 48" x 24": 48 x 1024 = 49152 and 24 x 1024 = 24576. Nothing overhangs the top, so the table's extent is the top's.

boxes.name: Top
boxes.derivation: Origin of the design. 48" x 1024 = 49152; 24" x 1024 = 24576. In space (format version 4): lying as drawn, face-up top. Its underside sits on the legs' tops, which are at the legs' stated length, 16 1/4" = 16.25 x 1024 = 16640, so its anchor z is 16640; its depth is its stated thickness, 3/4" = 0.75 x 1024 = 768, so its top surface is at 16640 + 768 = 17408 = 17".

boxes.name: Leg, south-west
boxes.derivation: Inset 1 1/2" from the top's west and south edges: 1.5 x 1024 = 1536 in both axes. 2 1/2" square = 2.5 x 1024 = 2560. Occupies x 1536..4096, y 1536..4096. In space: standing on the floor, face-up top, anchor z 0; its depth is its stated length, 16 1/4" = 16.25 x 1024 = 16640, so its top end is at z 16640.

boxes.name: Leg, south-east
boxes.derivation: Its east face is inset 1 1/2" from the top's east edge, so the face is at 48 - 1.5 = 46.5" and the anchor (the west face) at 46.5 - 2.5 = 44": 44 x 1024 = 45056. Same y as the south-west leg. Occupies x 45056..47616. In space: standing on the floor, face-up top, anchor z 0; its depth is its stated length, 16 1/4" = 16.25 x 1024 = 16640, so its top end is at z 16640.

boxes.name: Leg, north-west
boxes.derivation: North face inset 1 1/2" from the top's north edge: face at 24 - 1.5 = 22.5", anchor at 22.5 - 2.5 = 20": 20 x 1024 = 20480. Same x as the south-west leg. Occupies y 20480..23040. In space: standing on the floor, face-up top, anchor z 0; its depth is its stated length, 16 1/4" = 16.25 x 1024 = 16640, so its top end is at z 16640.

boxes.name: Leg, north-east
boxes.derivation: The east x of the south-east leg with the north y of the north-west leg: (45056, 20480). In space: standing on the floor, face-up top, anchor z 0; its depth is its stated length, 16 1/4" = 16.25 x 1024 = 16640, so its top end is at z 16640.

boxes.name: Apron, long, south
boxes.derivation: Runs between the legs along X: from the south-west leg's east face at 1.5 + 2.5 = 4" (4 x 1024 = 4096) to the south-east leg's west face at 44". Length 44 - 4 = 40" = 40960. Its south face is flush with the legs' south faces at y = 1.5" = 1536; thickness 3/4" = 768, so it occupies y 1536..2304. In space: on edge under the top, face-up top. Its depth is its stated vertical face, 3 1/2" = 3.5 x 1024 = 3584, and its upper edge is flush with the top's underside at 16640, so its anchor z is 16640 - 3584 = 13056 = 12 3/4" (12.75 x 1024).

boxes.name: Apron, long, north
boxes.derivation: Same length and thickness as the south long apron. Its north face is flush with the legs' north faces at y = 22.5", so the anchor (the south face) is at 22.5 - 0.75 = 21.75": 21.75 x 1024 = 22272. Occupies y 22272..23040. In space: on edge under the top, face-up top. Its depth is its stated vertical face, 3 1/2" = 3.5 x 1024 = 3584, and its upper edge is flush with the top's underside at 16640, so its anchor z is 16640 - 3584 = 13056 = 12 3/4" (12.75 x 1024).

Its west face is flush with the legs' west faces at x = 1.5" = 1536; thickness 3/4" = 768, so it occupies x 1536..2304. In space: on edge under the top, face-up top. Its depth is its stated vertical face, 3 1/2" = 3.5 x 1024 = 3584, and its upper edge is flush with the top's underside at 16640, so its anchor z is 16640 - 3584 = 13056 = 12 3/4" (12.75 x 1024).

boxes.derivation: Same length and thickness as the west short apron. Its east face is flush with the legs' east faces at x = 46.5", so the anchor (the west face) is at 46.5 - 0.75 = 45.75": 45.75 x 1024 = 46848. Occupies x 46848..47616. In space: on edge under the top, face-up top. Its depth is its stated vertical face, 3 1/2" = 3.5 x 1024 = 3584, and its upper edge is flush with the top's underside at 16640, so its anchor z is 16640 - 3584 = 13056 = 12 3/4" (12.75 x 1024).

cutList.label: Top
cutList.derivation: The top lies flat, so its plan axes are length across X and width up Y: length = the box's stored width 49152 (48" x 1024), width = the box's stored height 24576 (24" x 1024). The third dimension is the thickness the design states, 3/4": 0.75 x 1024 = 768. Text: 49152 / 1024 = 48" = 4 x 12 + 0 -> 4'-0"; 24576 / 1024 = 24" = 2 x 12 + 0 -> 2'-0"; 768 / 1024 = 3/4", under a foot so no feet are shown. One box, quantity 1, and one member so the label is its own name. No stock is named, so the material column is empty.

cutList.label: Apron, long
cutList.derivation: A long apron runs along X on edge: length across X = the box's stored width 40960 (44 - 4 = 40" between the legs, x 1024), thickness up Y = the box's stored height 768 (3/4" x 1024). The third dimension is the apron's vertical face, stated as 3 1/2": 3.5 x 1024 = 3584. Text: 40960 / 1024 = 40" = 3 x 12 + 4 -> 3'-4"; 3584 / 1024 = 3 1/2"; 768 / 1024 = 3/4". Two boxes with the same three dimensions and no stock, so one row of 1 + 1 = 2. Label: the two names "Apron, long, south" and "Apron, long, north" share "Apron, long, ", cut back to the last word boundary and stripped of trailing punctuation -> "Apron, long".

cutList.label: Leg
cutList.derivation: A leg stands up, so the plan holds its width and its thickness: both are the box's stored 2560 (2 1/2" x 1024 = 2560). The third dimension is its length, stated as 16 1/4": 16.25 x 1024 = 16640. Text: 16640 / 1024 = 16 1/4" = 1 x 12 + 4 1/4 -> 1'-4 1/4"; 2560 / 1024 = 2 1/2" twice. Four boxes with identical dimensions and no stock, so one row of 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4. Label: the four names share "Leg, " (south- and north- differ at the first letter), cut back to the last word boundary and stripped of its trailing comma -> "Leg".

cutList.label: Apron, short
cutList.derivation: A short apron runs along Y on edge, so the axes swap: thickness across X = the box's stored width 768 (3/4" x 1024), length up Y = the box's stored height 16384 (20 - 4 = 16" between the legs, x 1024). The third dimension is again the 3 1/2" face: 3.5 x 1024 = 3584. Text: 16384 / 1024 = 16" = 1 x 12 + 4 -> 1'-4"; 3584 / 1024 = 3 1/2"; 768 / 1024 = 3/4". Two boxes, one row of 2. Label: "Apron, short, west" and "Apron, short, east" share "Apron, short, " -> "Apron, short".

cutListOrder: Descending by length: 49152 > 40960 > 16640 > 16384, which is 48" > 40" > 16 1/4" > 16". No two rows tie on length, so the width, thickness and label tie-breaks are not exercised by this fixture.
cutListCsv: Cut list: finished sizes: joinery allowances included; before saw kerf (#138).

dimensionLabels.name: Leg width
dimensionLabels.derivation: 2560 / 1024 = 2.5"; under a foot, so no feet are shown: 2 and 8/16 reduced to 1/2.

dimensionLabels.name: Leg inset from the top's west edge
dimensionLabels.derivation: The south-west leg's south-west corner is at x = 1536 and the top's at x = 0, so the signed distance along X is 1536 - 0 = 1536 = 1.5".

notes: Format version 2 added a name to every entity and a part to every box, so the plan view carried the third dimension of each part in part.outOfPlane. The three numbers under statedNotInScene are where they came from: nothing new was invented for the cut list.

Format version 4 (docs/design/assembly-model.md §10) moved that third dimension onto the box as its depth and gave every box an anchor z and a face-up. The depths are the same three stated numbers; the z values are arithmetic on them, derived in each box's derivation above and in coffee-table.design.md: legs on the floor at 0, the top's underside on the legs' tops at 16640, the aprons' upper edges flush with it at 16640 - 3584 = 13056. Every box is face-up top. No relationship holds anything in Z — the relationships are the plan's, unchanged (§11 decision 9) — and the cut list, its CSV and every plan value above are byte for byte what they were: position and orientation are not read by the cut list (§5).

The cutList rows above are re-derived by hand from coffee-table.design.md, the same rule samples/README.md sets for every other number here. Each row's derivation shows the arithmetic and the label rule so a reviewer can re-check it without running anything.

No materials list is expected here. That arrives with #9; no part in this fixture names a stock, so every row's material column is empty and a shopping list would report the whole table under "no stock chosen".

The cut list's CSV gained a trailing Cuts column when cuts on a blank arrived (docs/design/shaped-parts-model.md §4.5). This table is five plain rectangles and stays that way — the rounded corners went into samples/rounded-corner-table instead (§8) — so the column is empty on every line and each row's line simply ends in one more comma. Nothing else in this file changed.
